info.name: PFM API — UM-US-01 Invite a User
info.description:
Exercises every acceptance criterion and edge case of SRS §6 Feature-01 · US-01-01 (SDS §5.2.1 UM-US-01).

Setup:
  cd backend
  uv run alembic upgrade head
  uv run python -m app.cli create-admin --email boss@example.com --password 'Str0ng-Passw0rd!'
  uv run python -m app.cli mint-token --email boss@example.com
  uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000

Paste the minted token into the `admin_token` collection variable.

`mint-token` is a dev stand-in for POST /api/v1/auth/login, which belongs to SS-US-01 and is not built yet (plan.md A11).

variable.description: Output of `uv run python -m app.cli mint-token --email boss@example.com`
A token for an ACTIVE non-ADMIN user, for the AC-04 403 case. Not obtainable yet — see that request's description.
An address with no account. Change it between runs, or the second call becomes an EC-02 re-invite.
The bootstrap ADMIN — an ACTIVE account, so inviting it must 409.

request.description: Expect 200 {"status":"ok",...}. The liveness probe the Deploy step checks.

Expect 201 with exactly six fields: id, email, status=PENDING, token_expires_at (24h out, UTC with offset), created_at, message='Invitation sent successfully'.

AC-08: there must be NO token in the response. The raw token goes only to the invited mailbox. With SMTP unconfigured the server logs a warning and records the message instead of sending — check the uvicorn output for the activation link.

item.name: EC-02 — Re-invite the same PENDING address (201, token rotated)

request.description:
Run immediately after AC-01. Expect 201, the SAME id, and message='A new invitation has been sent. The previous link no longer works.'

The previous invitation is now SUPERSEDED and its link is dead; the new expiry restarts from now. This is the recovery path when an invitation expired or never arrived.

Expect 409 USER_EMAIL_ALREADY_ACTIVE, 'An account with this email already exists'.

This deliberately discloses that the address is in use — constitution SEC-10's documented exemption, because an ADMIN needs to know why the invite failed.

item.name: EC-01 — Same address, different case and whitespace (409)

request.description: Expect 409. Trimmed and case-folded before comparison, so one mailbox maps to exactly one account and no duplicate can be created by changing capitalisation.
Expect 422 VALIDATION_ERROR with details.fields locating ["body","email"]. Also try: @nolocal.com, 'spaces in@email.com', a@b@c.com, empty string.
Expect 422 VALIDATION_ERROR, type 'missing'. All field errors are returned together (constitution VL-02).
321 characters — one past the inclusive 320 maximum. Expect 422, and confirm the address was NOT silently truncated to fit.
Expect 401 NOT_AUTHENTICATED. Absent, invalid and expired credentials all produce the same message — distinguishing them would tell an attacker which half to work on.

item.name: AC-05 — Credentials checked before payload (401, not 422)

request.description: Malformed payload AND no credentials. Expect 401, NOT 422 — an unauthenticated caller must learn nothing about payload validity (plan.md A8).
Expect 401. Also try a token signed with a different secret, and one whose `exp` has passed.

Expect 403 FORBIDDEN.

NOT RUNNABLE YET: this needs an ACTIVE user whose role is USER, and there is no way to produce one. `create-admin` only makes ADMINs, and an invited account stays PENDING until UM-US-02 (activate) is built — a PENDING account cannot hold a token at all.

AC-04 is covered instead by the pytest case TC-11 (test_a_non_admin_caller_is_denied), which constructs the USER directly. Run `uv run pytest -k non_admin` to see it.

item.name: EC-07 — Sync-mode delivery failure (502) — SEE DESCRIPTION

request.description:
Expect 502 EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILED.

Requires the server restarted with BOTH:
  EMAIL_SEND_MODE=sync
  SMTP_USER / SMTP_PASSWORD set to something that will fail to authenticate

With SMTP entirely unconfigured the server falls back to a recording sender that always succeeds, so you get 201 instead. The point of this case is that success is never reported for mail that was not sent.
